correctness.rationale: For two groups both of size m split across two labeled strata with all 8 binary cells strictly positive, an arm's four cells are exactly a positive composition of m. There are binom(m-1,3)^2 tables in total. Writing stratum-1 group sizes a,b and events x,y and stratum-2 events u,v, exact reversal is xb<ya, u(m-b)<v(m-a), x+u>y+v. Independently re-enumerated every positive-table case for each m=4,...,11 using direct integer loops and exact cross-products, obtaining reversal counts 0,0,0,0,0,0,0,4, first solution set [(3,8,1,3,5,2),(4,7,1,2,5,3),(7,4,5,3,1,2),(8,3,5,2,1,3)]. Swap of strata forms two orbits. Example 1/3<3/8,5/8<2/3 yet 6/11>5/11. Since m<4 is impossible under 4 positive cells per arm, total 22 is sharp. Positive cells ensure odds/risk ratio association sign tracks risk difference. This is a complete finite proof, not sampling.
